root_cause: The existing eight identical daily source queries repeatedly returned topic-family duplicates; two freshly dated results on 2026-10-29 passed individual signal checks but were rejected by the original 3-day topic uniqueness gate.
prevention_rule: Rotate eight existing news search slots deterministically across twelve approved enterprise problem categories by original business date; preserve verified source-publication timestamps, 60-day freshness, 90-day URL/hash uniqueness, three-day topic spacing, exact media identity and canonical publisher exclusivity. Never claim publication without provider ID/readback.
regression_contract: Pure deterministic date-to-query selection: eight unique approved searches per business date; twelve topics over three dates; fail-closed invalid date; existing provenance/dedupe/media gates unchanged.
